notes.title: Update 2.4.3
Обновление 2.4.2
notes.notes:
[h3]This update features:[/h3]
- autosave on/off button;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/e8f2149f46e0e4c6352b30f7a504e0ca76122c2e.gif[/img]

- The interaction between the users with screens of different resolutions has been improved. Now you don’t have to include your screen’s resolution in the settings file (config.json). Besides, the number of resolutions available for the window mode has increased. 

[i]Note: the settings file doesn’t have "auto_save" field anymore since the earlier updates have provided the opportunity to use this option through the game interface.[/i] 

- For two years I studied the screen flickering problem that appeared when playing on graphic tablets. In the course of a comprehensive testing, the cause of the flickering has been identified, and a new app operation mode has been added. To use a graphic tablet, it is required to select the tablet coloring mode in the resolution selection menu. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/036327c2b5f9cecef92fbd0679339e309ae1800e.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 2.4 + Announcement: CG4
notes.notes:
The big 2.4 Update has finally arrived!

The game’s progress saving system has been revised, and the following new features have been added:
[list]
[*] data compression;
[*] file integrity verification;
[*] duplicate saving files. The system is now going to store the second-to-last saving. In case the latest saving is damaged, the game will load the previous saving automatically. This improves the overall system reliability and helps minimize progress loss in case of a failure.
[/list]

The panel for running image/animation scaling has been added. Previously the animation scaling option did not exist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34441701/a977b264bfc48a6410b4ad9f008401b19ef55ff0.gif[/img]


The opportunity to control the scrollbar visualization has been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34441701/8439904c0c0e2e550fa2722a1fe824620f2b881d.gif[/img]

Coloring Game’s fans will be able to play the franchise’s last part very soon.

notes.title: Breaking News.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34441701/31096204ba69c21936d7b14a5fd152b4b258c7fe.png[/img]

[h1]Update for EP3  +150,000px[/h1]
5 new images have been added to the EP3. The full release of the DLC is going to take place on October 14.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153630/Coloring_Game__Expansion_Pack_No_3/

[h1]News Concerning the Update 1.5.0[/h1]
During almost the whole month of September I was trying to introduce to the game the option of adding user images. Unfortunately, this is not possible without major modification of the game core. The possibility of loading user images wasn’t provided by the initial algorithm of the game elaboration. When I recently tried to modify the core, it had an immediate impact on the game stability.

I’ve decided to make the planned update 1.5.0 a separate app with new images to color and with the opportunity to add user images. The working title of the game is [b]Coloring Game 2[/b].
The release is scheduled for [b]Q1 2020[/b]. 
The base game is going to be free of charge while the extended version with the option of loading user images will cost [b]$3-5[/b].


[h1]New Game in the Coloring Game Collection[/h1]
Since the Coloring Game isn’t going to have new DLCs, we’ve decided to release new packs of images in the form of separate games. 
Besides, not all the users fancy coloring large images, so the first separate game is going to be a nice surprise for them.
[b]Price: 1.99$[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173830/Coloring_Game_Pixel/

notes.title: Hot news!
notes.notes:
Since the previous DLC was released, I’ve received numerous requests to complement the next one with more images of Mike and Emma. I’ve decided to create a whole new DLC called “The Family”.
This is the first theme-based DLC for the Coloring Game which is fully dedicated to a single family. 

The DLC is going to be released on June 21.
It will include 30 images. The total size of all the images will be over 1,700,000px. 
Unfortunately, we won’t be able to prepare the whole package till June 21 (due to a big number of large images), and that is why the release is going to be divided into 3 stages:
[list]
[*] June 21 – release of the first 25 images (~720,000px).
[*] July 3 – addition of another 3 400x400 images (480,000px).
[*] July 12 – addition of the last 2 500x500 images (500,000px).    
[/list] 

The base price of the DLC is [b]$7.99[/b]. The players who are already in possession of the previous DLCs will be able to purchase the new one with a 20% discount (a corresponding bundle is going to be offered).  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105010/Coloring_Game__The_Family/

In light of all the latest news, the EP2 release is postponed for July (the approximate release date is July 26). EP2 will most likely be the last DLC for the Coloring Game. 

[i]Updated information on the Trading Cards. Unfortunately, in order for them to be added, the free game should feature either in-game purchases or items. Besides, to obtain trading cards in the free game, players would have to spend not less than $9. That is why the addition of Trading Cards has been canceled.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
In this update the following options have been added:
[list]
[*] Hints system: H key. Highlighting of uncolored pixels on the minimap.
[*] Opportunity to draw lines at an arbitrary angle: Ctrl + the left mouse button.
[*] Disabled display of the pixels on the minimap once they are colored.  
[*] Automatic color switch after the completion of the current color in the full-screen workspace mode.
[*] The buttons have been added which duplicate several of the functions that feature in the game with the update 1.2.0.
[*] From now on the save indicator can be disabled. To do this, go to the file config.json and substitute the line "save_indicator":true with "save_indicator":false.
[/list]

Trading cards are going to be added on June18 simultaneously with the release of the third DLC. 
[b]UPD: Trading cards will not be. Trading cards are canceled. For paid DLСs players can not get cards. ːsteamsadː [/b]
 

[h1]Hot news![/h1]

Our secret laboratory has bred a cute animal which is to become your assistant – Joe, the three-toed sloth. Currently Joe is undergoing the preparatory training.

In case for some reason you need assistance in coloring the image, Joe will always be there to help you. 

Joe’s skills: 
[list]
[*] four coloring modes;
[*] the coloring speed is 3-4 times lower than that of an average player.
[/list]

Joe is going to be added in the update 1.4.0 which is planned to be released in the first half of July.

notes.title: Soon: Coloring Game - Mini Pack
notes.notes:
Nice surprise for all Coloring Game lovers

I’ve received numerous requests to make a small and low-cost DLC for the game. Though I initially didn’t plan to develop such a DLC, I’ve eventually decided to release a “Mini Pack”. Unless some unforeseen circumstances take place, the DLC will be released on [b]May 31 (UPD)[/b].

The DLC is going to contain 20 original levels. The total size of all the images will be [i]340,000px[/i], which is one and a half times more than the base game and three times less than EP1.

The “Mini Pack” will delight not only the loyal fans of the game who are waiting for EP2 but also those users who enjoy playing but don’t like coloring large images.

[h1]The base price of the game is [b]$1.99[/b] but I’m happy to offer a [b]15%[/b] discount on the occasion of the game release.[/h1]

As with EP1, before purchasing the DLC you’ll be able to preview its contents.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090860/Coloring_Game__Mini_Pack/

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
A new level 30 has been added to the DLC. It is two times larger than the one which has been lost (330,000 vs. 160,000). ːsteamhappyː

[h1]The update includes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Workspace scrolling by moving the mouse while holding a button. Three options for programming the buttons are available. 
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34441701/50881e9623e8fba1ee819e1db653aeefa94711e6.png[/img]
[list]
[b]I recommend the third option: [/b]
[list]
[*]hold the right mouse button and move the mouse to perform scrolling;
[*]double click on the right mouse button to select the color.
[/list]

[*]Full screen workspace mode has been added (removes the right side panels). [b]F key.[/b]

[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34441701/8eca21e358aa2c17fa390ac1a126ac78210dad25.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Size setting for the right side panels.[b] P key.[/b]
[*]Color selection by number by using number keys. For selecting double-digit colors, hold the Shift key and use the number keys.
[*]I have introduced restrictions on the preview window update for large images (>= 50,000). From now on an image will be updated only after at least 10px are colored. Fine tuning of the preview windows will be added in the update 1.3.0.
[/list]

The update 1.3.0 is going to be released in the first half of June. It will feature new tools for comfortable playing.


[h1]F.A.Q.[/h1]

[h1]How many DLCs are going to be released?[/h1]

 - I initially planned to make four commercial DLCs: three DLCs with images and one workshop. The first two DLCs are sure to be released while the creation of the third and the fourth one depends on the sales of the first two DLCs.

[i]The game development is not a hobby for us but the main source of income. Our development team consists of two full-time office employees. Therefore, the decision concerning the release of DLCs is always taken on the basis of economic viability.[/i]

[h1]- What’s coming next?[/h1]

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.notes:
During the three weeks that have passed since the game release I’ve been constantly receiving complaints on the game performance. Unfortunately, all the attempts to fix the problem have failed, and no update has helped improve the game performance, despite the fact that this was a priority task for me.

I came back to the problem after the update 1.1.1 was released. Four days of a rather hard work produced a positive result – I’ve managed to identify the root of the problem and to fix it.
It turned out that the game performance was undermined by a third-party library which used to cause memory leak and, consequently, occasional app collapses.

In this update I have:
[list]
[*] fixed the memory leak error;
[*] performed the code refactoring which will additionally improve the app performance;
[*] done so that the coloring mode won’t be cancelled anymore in case the cursor is moved outside the workspace.
[/list]

notes.title: Announcement of 1.1.0 update
notes.notes:
I have three pieces of news for you: two good ones and a bad one.

[h1]Good News No.1:[/h1]
You’ve probably already noticed that one major problem has been identified since the game was released. It’s a considerable performance slowdown when the number of pixels in the workspace is more than 5,000. 
 
For example, if the screen resolution is 1920x1080, the workspace for the minimal scale is 108x96 = 10,360px, which produces a rather perceptible delay when trying to change colors or perform scrolling. 

This problem doesn’t allow playing comfortably:
[list][*] on screens with high resolution;
[*] with the minimal scale;
[*] on low-end video cards and laptops.
[/list]

Technical quality of the game is the priority task for me, and that is why I’ve decided to make a major refactoring of the game code.
I’m planning to finish it in 3-4 days’ time and then release the 1.1.0 update.

[h1]Bad News:[/h1]
Due to the necessity to redesign the game code for the 1.1.0 update, the DLC release is postponed for a week and is going to take place on May 3. 
That gives you some extra time to save money for the purchase of the DLC, though ːsteamhappyː
[i]The base price of the DLC is[b] $4.99[/b].[/i]

[h1]Good News No.2 (compensation for the postponement of the DLC release date):[/h1]
On April 26-27 the 1.1.1 update is going to be released, which will feature 5 new images for the base game.
